title: Ping
description: Creates temporary waypoints for your friends to know your location
body:
Ping is a client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.8 that lets you create temporary waypoint beacons and share them through chat with other players using the mod.

Look at a block or entity, press your configured ping key, and Ping sends a compact chat payload containing the location. Any player with the mod installed can detect that message in chat and render the waypoint in their world if they are in the same dimension.

Features
- Create waypoint pings from what you are looking at
- Share pings through normal chat or team chat
- Render tall, visible beacon-style markers at the pinged location
- Show distance labels on screen
- Configure ping color, duration, and command format
- Mod Menu config screen support
- Client-side only
  
Notes
- This mod does not require server installation
- Other players need the mod to see the waypoint markers
- The chat message must preserve the embedded ping payload for detection to work
